inputs.prompt: A huge sand shark, a monster that swims through desert sand like water. Dusty red brown back, pale cream belly, a huge jaw full of jagged bone white teeth, a tall blade shaped dorsal fin, a ridge of spines running down its back, and a heavy powerful tail, each of them clearly visible. Old spear scars and broken spear shafts stuck in its hide from the hunters who chase it. Menacing, not cartoony. It twists sideways across the top of the sand in a tight curve like an eel, its long serpentine body coiled so its jaw, fin, spines and tail all show at once. The spines along its back are a crest of long jagged bone blades. Creature concept art for a dark fantasy video game, in the mood of an 80s dark fantasy film. Painted, with clear shapes and a strong readable silhouette. Full body, the whole creature inside the frame, seen in a three quarter view and facing left. Plain flat light grey background with soft even light, no scenery, no people, no text, no border.
